description: The crashlog base URLs (production, staging, slot-derived local dev collector) and the debug-only staging switch exist once per shell, because each reads its own preference store and each debug build reaches localhost differently (browser localhost, simulator localhost, emulator 10.0.2.2).
note: Change a host in all three copies in one commit. Release builds must always resolve to production; only debug/dev builds may select local or staging. Production/staging hosts remain deployment constants. The local port comes only from scripts/lib/slot.mjs: Vite embeds it, Gradle projects it into BuildConfig, and the iOS post-build phase writes developer ports into the Debug bundle on the build host.
